publicReleaseNotes: Uptime 0.5.12 refreshes local sign-in guidance. The sign-in gate explains opening the private terminal link or running rer dev --as owner; it shows how to sign in as an invited person when one is available. Keep the printed link private because it gives access to the local installation; an enrolled second factor is still required. A refused local one-click link gives a plain next step, and cross-site one-click requests without the explicit local key are refused. The local command guide documents running downloaded JavaScript tools with rer's installed runtime through rer run --script, without separate Node or pnpm on PATH. The checkout pins @runeditrun/rer to 0.2.113, replacing 0.2.108 from 0.5.11; update an existing checkout with pnpm install --frozen-lockfile. No migration or new required settings; monitors, history, incidents, destinations and private settings are kept on upgrade. Known limits from 0.5.11 remain: earlier heartbeat output is not rewritten and pattern-based redaction can miss an unrecognizable unlabelled secret not listed under Output text to mask; UptimeRobot monitor CSV import remains unavailable; restoring an archive does not restore the erased-people list, so pairing again can reinvite someone still listed by the Business; a signed agent policy without company settings returns an empty decision feed; responses over 64 KiB fail the check. Hosted heartbeat evaluation needs a private runner, hosted Worker checks cannot pin connections, and a non-owner member with an enrolled second factor still verifies each new sign-in with the command line. Bounded-memory archive restore and operation at 500 monitors with 90 days of history remain unestablished; time-range selection and console chunk-transfer controls remain unavailable. Other earlier release limits remain. The product screenshot was taken on 0.4.0, before the console changes of 0.5.0 through 0.5.12.
